_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all software-visible PROACT hardware. Derived from the FROZEN ASIC RTL (ASIC/rtl/PROACTPKG/config_defs.svh, SCreg/s_c_REG_pkg.sv + s_c_REG.sv), verified against PROACT_signoff.v (tapeout 2025-11-14). scripts/gen_hardware.py generates the C header (controller) and Python module from this file so C/Python/GUI/docs never disagree. DO NOT hand-edit the generated files; edit THIS and regenerate. ASIC and FPGA share this map byte-for-byte.
_clock_note: Core clock. Divisor 27 -> ~115741 baud (host uses 115200) and the ~4340-cycle putchar pacing both imply ~50 MHz. Confirm on the bench.

devices.name: RNG
devices.note: write=seed; read routed only to Sw-RV

devices.name: CORE_UNIMPLEMENTED
devices.note: HAZARD: no hardware instance -> access HANGS the CPU. Never touch.

control_bits._comment: WRITE side of SCREG. 31-bit register: data bit31 is TRUNCATED by hardware, so trigger is bit30 (0x40000000), NOT bit31.

status_bits._comment: READ side of SCREG. True 32-bit register. Bits[31:17] written by Sw-RV; bit31 = live target-done handshake / Sw-RV trigger source.

aes_offsets._comment: relative to AES1/AES2 base; AES_fifo_interface.sv 60-74. Read+write ack only when the core's enable bit is set.

aead_offsets._comment: relative to ASCON/Xoodyak base; ASCON_fifo_interface.sv 62-68 (Xoodyak identical). LEN = {triggercfg[23:16], pt_len[15:8], ad_len[7:0]}, byte lengths.

mailbox._comment: controller<->Sw-RV shared data-RAM mailbox (aligned; same absolute address both sides).

swrv_trigger._comment: Sw-RV writes status bit31 via addr[29] port B; with cfg_sel=SWRV this is the capture trigger. This IS 32-bit-correct (unlike control bit31).
